defaults.rollback: Revert the single scoped work-package commit.
defaults.uiInvariant: Preserve existing UI, interaction, behavior, copy, and user expectations unless the package explicitly adds an approved commercial or compliance surface.

packages.title: Governance baseline
packages.objective: Establish the rewrite authority documents.
acceptance: Governance documents are UTF-8 and internally consistent

packages.title: Governance check
packages.objective: Make governance rules machine verifiable.
acceptance: Conflicting architecture rules fail the check

packages.title: Workspace scaffold
packages.objective: Create isolated rewrite workspaces and strict tooling.
deliverables: Web, API, Worker, and shared package workspaces
acceptance: Rewrite builds independently and legacy defaults remain unchanged

packages.title: Backend platform
packages.objective: Establish NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, queue, storage, and health foundations.
acceptance: API and Worker compose independently with strict production config

packages.title: Home platform APIs
packages.objective: Provide auth, models, credits, projects, uploads, jobs, and feed APIs.
acceptance: Home APIs use stable contracts and tenant scoping

packages.title: Durable AI worker
packages.objective: Execute durable image jobs with exactly-once credit effects.
deliverables: Outbox dispatch, recovery, and image provider execution
acceptance: Duplicate delivery cannot duplicate charges

packages.title: React home
packages.objective: Rebuild the full home experience with visual and behavioral parity.
acceptance: Existing home UI and interactions remain equivalent

packages.title: Minimal React canvas receiver
packages.objective: Receive pending and completed home jobs in a versioned canvas document.
acceptance: Pending becomes a stable persisted result without temporary nodes

packages.title: Autonomous work-package catalog
packages.objective: Make the complete migration sequence decision-complete and machine verifiable.
acceptance: Every package has paths, checks, acceptance, rollback, blockers, and one successor
The next package is catalog-backed and unblocked

packages.title: Motion and tiered verification policy
packages.objective: Authorize bounded rewrite polish and replace repeated full-repository checks with risk-tiered verification.
acceptance: Only approved rewrite visual deltas are permitted and Legacy remains read-only
Every catalog package has a verification tier and executable command source
Affected workspaces are derived from staged paths and local dependents
Stage and release gates retain full repository checks

packages.title: React iOS-style polish
packages.objective: Apply one bounded rewrite-only icon, motion, spacing, overflow, touch-target, and safe-area polish pass.
targetedChecks: Playwright 1440x1000 and 390x844 screenshots for home, menus, attachments, and pending/result canvas
acceptance: Existing React structure, routes, behavior, generation flow, canvas coordinates, and breakpoints remain unchanged
Only catalogued visual delta IDs differ from the legacy reference
Lucide icons are named imports with accessible labels and no whole-library chunk
Reduced motion, keyboard focus, 44px touch targets, safe areas, and text overflow pass
Legacy files remain unchanged

packages.title: Capability registry
packages.objective: Expose fail-closed external-service readiness without leaking credentials.
acceptance: Capabilities are disabled, development, configured, or verified; production actions require verified

packages.title: Identity provider seams
packages.objective: Add email, SMS, WeChat, QQ, captcha, and risk provider contracts.
deliverables: Identity provider contracts and deterministic development implementations
acceptance: Unconfigured production providers fail with PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED and HTTP 503

packages.title: Moderation, notification, and audit seams
packages.objective: Create durable moderation, delivery, and audit boundaries.
deliverables: Provider contracts, durable records, retry states
acceptance: Failures are durable and retryable; audit events are immutable

packages.title: Billing domain foundation
packages.objective: Build payment-independent commercial state machines and ledgers.
deliverables: Plans, prices, orders, payments, subscriptions, mandates, entitlements, refunds, and invoices
targetedChecks: Clean PostgreSQL migration and transaction checks
acceptance: Money uses integer fen; commercial history is append-only and idempotent

packages.title: Payment provider contracts
packages.objective: Define WeChat Pay, Alipay, renewal, webhook, refund, query, and reconciliation contracts.
deliverables: Fail-closed payment provider interfaces and official signature fixtures
targetedChecks: Provider contract tests for signatures, replay, refund, and reconciliation
acceptance: Missing credentials cannot create a successful payment or entitlement

packages.title: Commercial pages
packages.objective: Add complete account and commercial pages using existing visual language.
deliverables: Pricing, account, billing, credits, security, and data pages
targetedChecks: Playwright desktop and mobile additive-entry comparison
acceptance: Existing surfaces are unchanged except approved entries; unavailable payments are clearly disabled

packages.title: Compliance pages and data rights
packages.objective: Add legal, report, appeal, deletion, and export workflows without pretending regulatory approval.
deliverables: Terms, privacy, refund, AI disclosure, report, appeal, deletion, and export surfaces
acceptance: Data-rights requests are authenticated, durable, auditable, and fail closed

packages.title: Canvas document and node registry
packages.objective: Define versioned nodes, serializers, migrations, and validation.
deliverables: Node registry and snapshot migration registry
acceptance: Unknown or temporary nodes cannot corrupt restored documents

packages.title: Viewport coordinate system
packages.objective: Implement pan, zoom, fit, and pointer/world transforms.
targetedChecks: Canvas geometry and pointer round-trip tests
acceptance: Pointer and world coordinates do not drift at supported zoom levels

packages.title: Command and history
packages.objective: Implement reversible editor commands and bounded undo/redo.
targetedChecks: Command inversion and history boundary tests
acceptance: Undo and redo preserve document identity and selection invariants

packages.title: Selection model
packages.objective: Implement single, multi, marquee, clear, and focus-safe selection.
acceptance: Selection matches legacy click, modifier, and marquee behavior

packages.title: Drag and resize
packages.objective: Implement pointer-driven node and multi-node transforms.
deliverables: Drag, resize, bounds, and aspect rules
targetedChecks: Pointer path, bounds, aspect, and multi-node transform tests
acceptance: Transforms follow the actual pointer and produce stable commands

packages.title: React canvas adapter
packages.objective: Render engine state through granular Zustand selectors.
deliverables: Canvas store adapter and node renderer registry
acceptance: High-frequency pointer movement does not rerender the full React tree

packages.title: Canvas performance gate
packages.objective: Establish measurable interaction budgets for 500 nodes.
acceptance: Pan, zoom, selection, drag, and resize remain interactive at the documented budget

packages.title: Canvas tool rail
packages.objective: Restore original icons, colors, active states, collapse, and submenu behavior.
targetedChecks: Playwright desktop and mobile tool-rail comparison
acceptance: No icon, color, layout, hover, click, or submenu drift

packages.title: Shapes and arrows
packages.objective: Migrate all shape and arrow creation and formatting.
acceptance: All legacy shapes and arrows match creation and formatting behavior

packages.title: Text tool
packages.objective: Migrate text creation, editing, selection, and formatting.
acceptance: Fonts, style, size, color, editing, and focus match legacy

packages.title: Pen tool
packages.objective: Migrate pointer-following freehand drawing and formatting.
acceptance: Rendered path follows recorded user pointer samples

packages.title: Laser pen and eraser
packages.objective: Migrate transient laser animation and eraser hit testing.
deliverables: Laser and eraser pointer state machines
acceptance: Animation and erasure follow actual pointer coordinates and legacy timing

packages.title: Formatting toolbars
packages.objective: Complete shape and text formatting controls and selection binding.
acceptance: Controls remain aligned, complete, and bound to selected nodes

packages.title: Image toolbar
packages.objective: Migrate image action toolbar and command routing.
acceptance: Crop, upscale, background, expand, text, and 3D entries match legacy

packages.title: Crop, upscale, and expand
packages.objective: Migrate image transformation overlays and job handoff.
deliverables: Crop, upscale, background, expand, and text workflows
acceptance: Existing image commands retain geometry, save timing, and failure behavior

packages.title: 3D action and model nodes
packages.objective: Migrate 3D action entry, model nodes, and lazy preview shell.
acceptance: 3D remains lazy, visible, framed, and behaviorally equivalent

packages.title: Keyboard, stack, and editor commands
packages.objective: Complete shortcuts, stacking, alignment, clipboard, and deletion.
acceptance: All existing shortcuts and stacking operations are equivalent

packages.title: Chat composer
packages.objective: Migrate prompt, files, model selection, and send behavior.
acceptance: Input, files, model, send, focus, and errors match legacy

packages.title: Canvas reference images
packages.objective: Synchronize selected canvas images into chat references.
acceptance: Selection instantly produces the expected removable reference thumbnail

packages.title: Conversation persistence
packages.objective: Persist workspace-scoped conversations, messages, and recovery state.
acceptance: Refresh restores messages and active jobs without cross-workspace access

packages.title: Image generation workflow
packages.objective: Migrate image generator, references, pending, results, and billing.
acceptance: Pending replacement, charges, save timing, and errors match legacy

packages.title: Image edit workflow
packages.objective: Migrate image editing, references, replacement, and recovery.
acceptance: Edit output, replacement, metadata, and recovery match legacy

packages.title: Video generation workflow
packages.objective: Migrate lazy video generation, polling, output, and recovery.
acceptance: Video jobs survive refresh and preserve existing UI behavior

packages.title: Heavy 3D viewer
packages.objective: Complete lazy Three.js viewer, controls, loading, and failure states.
targetedChecks: Playwright screenshots, canvas pixels, and controls
acceptance: Viewer is nonblank, correctly framed, interactive, and lazy

packages.title: Task log and job recovery
packages.objective: Migrate task list, filters, detail, refresh, and durable recovery.
acceptance: Queued, running, success, failed, and cancelled states recover correctly

packages.title: Project CRUD
packages.objective: Complete create, list, open, update, delete, and conflict behavior.
acceptance: Save and delete claims follow backend results and rollback on failure

packages.title: Snapshot versioning
packages.objective: Complete CanvasDocument migrations, optimistic saves, and recovery.
acceptance: Old supported snapshots upgrade safely and temporary nodes never persist

packages.title: Protected media
packages.objective: Enforce workspace-scoped upload, read, download, and metadata access.
deliverables: Protected media APIs and stable downloads
acceptance: Unauthorized media access is denied without leaking storage keys

packages.title: Asset collections
packages.objective: Migrate asset library, collections, move, favorite, preview, and insertion.
targetedChecks: Playwright library and canvas insertion checks
acceptance: Library workflows and insertion coordinates match legacy

packages.title: Project thumbnails
packages.objective: Generate and restore stable home and project-library thumbnails.
acceptance: Thumbnail URLs are stable, protected, and environment independent

packages.title: Orphan media audit
packages.objective: Detect unreferenced objects without unsafe automatic deletion.
deliverables: Read-only orphan audit and guarded cleanup contract
targetedChecks: Reference graph and dry-run audit tests
acceptance: Referenced files are never classified as deletable

packages.title: Plans and entitlements
packages.objective: Activate authoritative plan catalogs and entitlement evaluation.
acceptance: Production catalog is explicit, versioned, and not seeded from development defaults

packages.title: Order and payment orchestration
packages.objective: Connect orders, payment attempts, webhooks, ledger, and entitlements.
targetedChecks: Idempotency, duplicate webhook, and entitlement tests
acceptance: Only verified provider results grant paid entitlements

packages.title: WeChat Pay adapter
packages.objective: Implement and verify WeChat Pay, refund, query, and renewal mandate integration.
acceptance: Signatures, callbacks, queries, refunds, and mandates pass live verification

packages.title: Alipay adapter
packages.objective: Implement and verify Alipay, refund, query, and renewal agreement integration.
acceptance: Signatures, callbacks, queries, refunds, and agreements pass live verification

packages.title: Subscriptions and renewal
packages.objective: Complete sign-up, renewal, grace, reminder, cancellation, and entitlement transitions.
targetedChecks: Time-controlled renewal, grace, reminder, and cancellation tests
acceptance: Cancellation is immediately accessible and renewal evidence is auditable

packages.title: Refunds and invoices
packages.objective: Complete refund requests, provider outcomes, ledgers, and invoice workflows.
targetedChecks: Partial/full refund and invoice status tests
acceptance: Provider result and local ledger remain reconcilable and append-only

packages.title: Payment reconciliation
packages.objective: Reconcile orders, provider statements, subscriptions, refunds, and ledgers.
targetedChecks: Missing, duplicate, and mismatched statement fixture tests
acceptance: Discrepancies are durable, alertable, and never silently corrected

packages.title: Commercial activation
packages.objective: Enable verified commercial capabilities and complete account flows.
deliverables: Verified checkout, billing, subscription, refund, and invoice UI
acceptance: All commercial actions are backed by verified provider and ledger truth

packages.title: Legal documents and acceptance
packages.objective: Version legal texts and record authenticated acceptance evidence.
deliverables: Versioned terms, privacy, refund, and disclosure
targetedChecks: Document version and acceptance evidence tests
acceptance: Required legal versions and acceptance timestamps are auditable

packages.title: Content moderation
packages.objective: Moderate inputs and outputs with durable decisions and appeals.
deliverables: Production moderation adapter and case workflow
targetedChecks: Allow, reject, timeout, retry, and appeal tests
acceptance: Unsafe content fails closed according to documented policy

packages.title: AI content labeling
packages.objective: Apply visible and metadata labels to generated exports.
targetedChecks: Image, video, and model export label tests
acceptance: All required exports carry durable visible and metadata labels

packages.title: Complaints and appeals
packages.objective: Complete report, complaint, appeal, evidence, and resolution workflows.
targetedChecks: Authorization, evidence, status, and audit tests
acceptance: Cases are workspace scoped, traceable, and cannot be silently discarded

packages.title: Account deletion
packages.objective: Implement confirmation, revocation, retention, and deletion orchestration.
targetedChecks: Re-authentication, cancellation, retention, and deletion tests
acceptance: Sessions revoke immediately and retained records follow documented policy

packages.title: Data export
packages.objective: Produce authenticated, scoped, expiring user data exports.
deliverables: Durable export jobs and protected downloads
targetedChecks: Tenant scope, expiry, archive content, and audit tests
acceptance: Exports contain only the authenticated subject's permitted data

packages.title: Security and audit hardening
packages.objective: Complete CSRF, CSP, WAF assumptions, secret hygiene, upload protection, retention, and security audit coverage.
deliverables: Security gate and audit retention policy
targetedChecks: Security headers, CSRF, upload, secret, tenant, and audit tests
acceptance: No unresolved P0/P1 security finding remains

packages.title: Alibaba Cloud foundation
packages.objective: Define production accounts, network, DNS, secrets, environments, and infrastructure runbooks.
acceptance: No production secret is committed and network dependencies are explicit

packages.title: RDS PostgreSQL
packages.objective: Provision, migrate, secure, monitor, back up, and restore production PostgreSQL.
acceptance: RPO is at most 15 minutes and restore evidence exists

packages.title: Tair Redis
packages.objective: Provision and verify sessions, rate limits, BullMQ, outage behavior, and recovery.
targetedChecks: Redis outage, reconnect, duplicate delivery, and recovery drills
acceptance: Business truth remains durable when Redis is lost

packages.title: Private OSS
packages.objective: Provision private object storage, authorization, lifecycle, recovery, and audit.
deliverables: Production OSS provider and recovery runbook
targetedChecks: Private read, signed access, lifecycle, and recovery drills
acceptance: Objects are private, recoverable, and inaccessible across workspaces

packages.title: SAE API and Worker
packages.objective: Deploy independent API and Worker services with health, scaling, and rollback.
targetedChecks: Worker restart and deployment rollback drills
acceptance: API supports at least two instances and Worker recovers durable jobs

packages.title: Observability
packages.objective: Integrate structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts.
deliverables: SLS, ARMS, CloudMonitor dashboards and alerts
targetedChecks: Synthetic failure and alert delivery checks
acceptance: Auth, payment, queue, database, storage, and error-rate alerts are actionable

packages.title: Recovery and alert drills
packages.objective: Prove service, database, object, and deployment recovery against RPO/RTO.
targetedChecks: Backup, restore, Redis outage, OSS recovery, and rollback drills
acceptance: RPO is at most 15 minutes and RTO is at most 2 hours

packages.title: Full parity closure
packages.objective: Close every product parity item with automated and approved evidence.
targetedChecks: Full desktop and mobile Playwright parity suite
acceptance: Every parity matrix item is approved with evidence

packages.title: Contract and end-to-end release suite
packages.objective: Prove complete user, project, generation, asset, billing, and data-rights flows.
deliverables: Production-like API and browser E2E suite
acceptance: Critical happy and failure paths pass against production-like dependencies

packages.title: Performance release gate
packages.objective: Verify frontend, API, database, queue, and media performance budgets.
targetedChecks: Load, latency, bundle, canvas, and queue benchmarks
acceptance: Documented release budgets pass without hiding errors

packages.title: Security and failure drills
packages.objective: Complete security review and realistic dependency failure exercises.
deliverables: Security review and failure drill evidence
targetedChecks: Database, Redis, OSS, provider, and payment outage drills
acceptance: No P0/P1 issue and every critical failure has an exercised response

packages.title: External approvals and blockers
packages.objective: Resolve ICP, licensing, model registration, payment approval, and cross-border policy evidence.
acceptance: All production-cutover blockers are closed by authoritative evidence

packages.title: Release candidate
packages.objective: Freeze a release candidate with complete deployment and rollback evidence.
acceptance: No P0/P1 defect, all blockers closed, and cutoverAllowed is true

packages.title: Cutover rehearsal
packages.objective: Rehearse empty-database launch, DNS switch, monitoring, and internal rollback.
acceptance: Every operator step, owner, signal, and rollback trigger is proven

packages.title: Production cutover
packages.objective: Switch the public domain to the verified rewrite without legacy dual write.
targetedChecks: Live health, auth, generation, payment, storage, and monitoring smoke tests
acceptance: Rewrite serves production and legacy receives no new user data

packages.title: Post-cutover rollback window
packages.objective: Operate the defined observation and rewrite-only rollback window.
acceptance: No unresolved release-severity incident remains

packages.title: Stable observation
packages.objective: Complete the approved stability period with monitored production evidence.
deliverables: Stability evidence and deletion readiness decision
targetedChecks: SLO, incident, payment, queue, database, and storage review
acceptance: Observation period passes without unresolved release blocker

packages.title: Legacy reachability audit
packages.objective: Prove legacy runtime, styles, assets, and deploy paths are no longer required.
deliverables: Static, runtime, parity, and rollback deletion evidence
targetedChecks: Reachability, style entry, deployment, and production-reference audits
acceptance: Every deletion candidate has static and runtime proof plus a rollback point

packages.title: Legacy deletion
packages.objective: Delete only proven legacy files in one audited final package.
deliverables: Rewrite-only repository and final rollback commit
acceptance: Rewrite is the only runtime and all deletion evidence remains available

docs.description: Governance, UTF-8/JSON, staged scope, and staged diff checks.

workspace.description: Affected workspace typecheck, test, lint, and build.

multi-workspace.description: Affected workspace graph plus package-specific contract, schema, transaction, or recovery checks.

stage-gate.description: Full repository check/build plus stage acceptance and E2E evidence.

release-gate.description: Full repository and release, security, failure, and rollback evidence.
